(hūm̐)༄༅/ /rje btsun mkha' spyod rdo rje btsun mo'i bskyed rdzogs kyi dmigs rim khyer bde kun tshang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༈/na mo gu ru badza

tei:div.tei:p: (hūm̐)༄༅// rje btsun mkha' spyod rdo rje btsun mo'i bskyed rdzogs kyi dmigs rim khyer bde kun tshang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra wā ra hi/ bde chen ye shes 'gyur med stong pa'i mdangs// ma 'gags byi ru'i smin legs nyi ma brgya'i// dngos pos 'khyud pa'i dpal mo mchog sbyin mkhan// zhing sngags lhan skyes ḍā ki'i tshogs kyis skyongs// gdod ma'i skyabs gyur rang rig phag mo'i zhal// las nyon kun rtog gnyis 'dzin mun pa yis// sgrib las grol te mngon sum mjal ba'i thabs// rim gnyis lam du 'jug tshul mdo tsam bri// 'dir bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la thun mong ma yin pa'i gser chos bcu gsum yod pa'i nang nas jo bo nā ro ta pa nyid la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dngos su gnang pa'i zab chos rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i khrid kyi rnal 'byor nyams su len pa'i tshul la/ gang gis nyams su len pa'i gang zag rab bde mchog lū nag gang rung gi smin byed thob pa'am/ de ltar ma grub na kye rdor man ngag lugs lta bu'i dkyil 'khor du smin byed thob nas sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs legs par nos pa chag med kyi rgyun dang ldan zhing yar mar gyi tshes bcu'i mchod pa la brtson pas rab tshe 'di nyid la mkha' spyod 'grub pa'am/ 'bring gis 'chi kha/ tha mas bar dor mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur zhing*/ de dag gi nyams len gyi gtso bo ni bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig po 'dir ma 'dus pa med pas/ rnal 'byor bcu gcig ni/ nyal dang ldang dang bdud rtsi myong*// tshad med bla ma bdag lhar bskyed// 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs// ngag bzlas yid bzlas gnyis gcig yin// bsam gyis mi khyab rnal 'byor dang*// spyod lam gyi ni rnal 'byor te// de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig go

/zhes pa ltar bcu gcig yod pa las/ dang po nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ gnas khang gzhal yas khang dang*/ rang rje btsun ma rgyan dang phyag mtshan med pa'i skur gsal btab/ sngas mgor bla ma rdo rje chos bzhugs pa'i pang du mgo bzhag pa'i tshul du rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod par gnyid log par byed/ de'i dgos pa'am sbyang gzhi ni snod kyi 'jig rten 'jig pa dang*/ bcud kyi sems can 'chi ba dang*/ dud 'gro bzhin du bag med du gnyid log par byed pa thams cad sbyong byed nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyis sbyangs pas/ sbyangs 'bras chos sku thob par byed do// gnyis pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ tho rangs nam gyi brgyad cha lon pa na/ nam mkha' nas oṃ gsum ma'i sgra ḍā ma ru'i sgra skad du bsgrags pas gnyid sad par bsam la lhar gsal ba dang sngas mgor bla ma dang bcas pa gsal ba'i ngang las gnas khang la bltas pas/ dag gsal gnyis med kyi ngo bo chos 'byung dmar po/ grogs sogs ni rnal 'byor mar gsal btab/ bla ma la mos gus byas pas rang la thim nas rang sngar bas gsal bar bsam la ldang*/ de'i dgos pa'am sbyang gzhi ni snod kyi 'jig rten chags pa dang*/ bcud kyi sems can skye ba/ 'phral gyi 'gro 'dug byed pa thams cad sbyong byed ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis sbyangs pas/ sbyangs 'bras longs sku thob par byed do// gsum pa bdud rtsi myong ba ni/ rab bdud rtsi ril bu za zhing*/ med na bdud rtsi ril bu'i rgyun tsam yod pa'i chang la dmigs pas byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes myang bas snying ga'i bam̐ yig sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo mchod par bsam/ de'i dgos pa'am sbyang gzhi ni 'dod sred kyi bsam pas khrus byed pa dang*/ mu stegs byed la sogs pas lus la khrus byas pas sems kyi sdig pa 'dag pa'i chos su 'dod pa dang*/ 'dul ba las kyang khrus dang gtsang sbra bya bar gsungs pa sogs nyams len gyis ma zin pa thams cad sbyong byed bdud rtsi myong ba'i rnal 'byor gyis sbyangs pas sbyangs 'bras sprul sku thob par byed do// bzhi pa tshad med ces pas skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed gnyis ka bstan pas/

de yang thog mar dbugs rlung rngam pa rang babs su ma zhi'i bar thang chad pa ngal gso ba'i tshul gyis cung zad bzhag de nas gnas khang sogs la sems gtad pas 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur te stong nyid la ji tsam gnas kyi bar mnyam par bzhag de las sems 'phro na thog mar rang gnas pa'i sa phyogs thams cad bai ḍūr+ya'i sa gzhi la gser gyi mig mangs ris su bres pa/ mnan na nem byed cing btegs na spar byed pa/ reg na bde ba bskyed pa'i sa gzhi lag mthil ltar mnyam pa stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs sogs mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa rgya shin tu che ba mtho khyad tshangs pa'i 'jig rten tsam du slebs pa gser gyi rgya phibs nor bu'i tog la sogs pas brgyan pa/ gang gis skyabs su 'gro ba'i gang zag ni gzhal yas khang de'i dbus su rang nyid/ g.yas su pha/ g.yon du ma/ mdun du dgra 'dre/ rgyab tu nye 'brel 'khor g.yog mtha' skor du rigs drug gi sems can thams cad khrom 'tshogs pa bzhin yod par bsam/ gang la skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul ni/ spyir skyabs yul la theg pa che chung dang grub mtha' gong 'og gi 'dod tshul mang du yod kyang 'dir kun 'dus nor bu lugs su bsgom ste/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bla ma dang tha mi dad pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje chos sku mdog dmar po rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs sangs rgyas/ yon tan nor lha/ phrin las chos skyong ste/ skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur par bsams la/ tshul ji ltar skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la zhes pa'i tshe bdag gi rnam 'dren mdzad du gsol snyam pa dang*/

sangs rgyas la zhes pa'i tshe ston pa po mdzad du gsol snyam pa dang*/ chos la zhes pa'i tshe lam dngos mdzad du gsol snyam pa dang*/ dge 'dun la zhes pa'i tshe lam sgrub pa'i grogs mdzad du gsol snyam pa'i sgo nas skyabs 'gro bzhi skor tshar gang mar brjod/ mthar bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma de gdan seng khri nas yar dbu'i gtsug tor nas mar thugs ka'i thad du 'od dmar po'i rnam par zhu nas rang gi smin mtshams su thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang skyabs yul gyi sku gsung thugs dbyer med du gyur par bsam pa'i ngang la ci nus su mnyam par bzhag pa ni/ nges don gyi skyabs 'gro yin no// de nas sems bskyed ni/ mar gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom par bgyi'o snyam pa'i sgo nas jo bo nā ro ta pa'i bzhed pa ltar bdag gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes sogs tshar gsum brjod/ zhar byung rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang lus tha mal pa'i spyi bor pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ji ltar 'tshams pa/ de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de dang mnyam pa de'i steng du bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka sku mdog shel dkar gyi snod ltar phyi ltas nang gsal nang ltas phyi gsal ba sku tshad rang gi mtho tshad tsam pa/ g.yas gser gyi rdo rje dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu thugs kar bsnol bas yum la 'khyud pa/ mi'i thod pa leb mor rang sor lnga pa kha mig gi rnam pa gtod pa'i rtse mor gser gyi rtse phran dang bcas pa lnga'i dbu rgyan/ gzhan yang rus pa'i a long gi snyan rgyan/ rus phreng gi mgul rgyan smad rgyan se ral kha phyag gdub zhabs gdub sogs rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/

zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog gi mdun du rigs bdag mtshon byed rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pas brgyan pa/ de'i pang du yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog yab dang mtshungs pa g.yas gri gug 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba yab la stobs pa/ se ral kha ma gtogs pa'i rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ pad+ma'i skyil krung gis zhabs kyi byin pas yab la 'khril ba/ yab kyi thugs kar zla dkyil chung ngu zhig gi steng du hūm̐ dkar po spus bris pa lta bu zla ba la nas tsam ma reg pa gsal btab/ de las 'od zer dkar po bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ sku lus kyi phyir thon nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi thugs kar phog thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi thams cad 'od zer kha dog dkar po'i rnam par nam mkha'i khams khyab par tshur spyan drangs te rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim par bsam/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sogs brjod la rtse gcig tu khyed mkhyen snyam du gsol ba btab pas thugs ka'i hūm̐ las bdud rtsi dngul chu'i mdog can gyi rgyun nar nar babs/ yab kyi sku mer gyis gang*/ gsang gnas rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs yum gyi sku gang ste gnyis ka'i sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag med babs/ pad+ma'i sdong por 'khril ba rnams tshangs bug dang*/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma'i kha mtshams nas babs pa rnams brag g.yang nas chu 'phyar te babs pa bzhin babs pas lus phyir babs lus kyi phyi ma lus bkrus par bsam/ tshangs bug nas bdud rtsi babs pas mar ded pa'i tshul du lus kyi nang gi sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu dang sol khu'i rnam par bshang gci gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis nas 'thon par bsams la yig brgya

1 brjod/ gdon thams cad rta g.yag sdom sdig sogs kyi rnam pas ba spu'i bu ga nas thon par bsams la yig brgya 2 brjod/ nad thams cad rlangs pa sngo dmar gyi rnam pas thon par bsam la yig brgya 3 brjod pa ste thun mong pa'i dmigs pa gsum dang*/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun des smin mtshams yan gang*/ de yan chad gangs rir nyi ma shar ba ltar dkar sangs kyis song*/ de man chad cung mog pa'i rnam pa dang*/ bum pa'i dbang thob byung snyam pa dang*/ lus kyi dri ma dag song snyam pa dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi sku'i byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad thob par bsams la yig brgya brjod/ de bzhin du mgrin pa/ snying kha/ rkang mthil yan chad gang ba dang*/ gsang dbang*/ shes rab ye shes/ dbang bzhi pa rnams thob pa dang*/ ngag yid/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma thams cad dag pa dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las bcas kyi byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam la rim bzhin yig brgya brjod pa thun mong ma yin pa'i dmigs pa bzhi ste thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa bdun la nan tan byed cing yig brgya ji ltar 'os pa bzla/ mthar mgon po bdag ni sogs thal mo snying gar sbyar te brjod la/ rten gyi stobs rdor sems yab yum la/ sngar byas kyi mi dge ba'i las la 'gyod sems phyin chad mi bya snyam pa sogs bshags pa rtse gcig dang*/ mthar rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal nas rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig sgrib thams cad ngas dag par byas zin gyis phyin chad sdig pa'i las ma byed cig ces gsung bzhin yab yum gnyis pad zla nas yar dang dbu skra nas mar 'od du zhu/ thugs ka'i thad du 'od dkar ba 'tsher ba 'dril ba zhig tu zhu nas spyi bo nas thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang rdor sems yab yum gyi sku gsung thugs dbyer med du 'dres par brten/ rang lus shel sgong g.ya' dag pa lta bur gyur par bsams la 'dzin med du bzhag go

/lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ lam thams cad bla ma la brten nas bgrod dgos pas/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar dag gsal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs dang bcas pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su seṅge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid sangs rgyas rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa dbu skra ral pa'i cod pan can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ gzhon nu lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ dar dang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ de'i thugs sangs rgyas/ gsung dam chos/ sku dge 'dun/ yon tan nor lha/ phrin las chos skyong ste skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor bsgom/ de'i mtha' skor du mdun nas brtsams te pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan re re'i steng du sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang nas rang rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gsan yul gyi bla ma gang yin pa'i bar gyi bla ma brgyud pa rnams g.yon skor gyi tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ de thams cad dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pas bde stong gi sgra sgrogs pa'i ḍā ma ru 'khrol ba/ g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa gru mo g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing gzhon nu lang tsho dar la bab pa skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur par bsams la/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ rnams gsal btab la/ bla ma thams cad kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer dmar po bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros te rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems chos srung nor lha thams cad sprin phung 'thib pa ltar spyan drangs te byon par bsam la rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgya bya/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas bla ma re re la skyabs gnas cha tshang ba re re bstim ste bla ma thams cad skyabs gnas kun 'dus su bsgom la/ gang drin ma sogs gsol 'debs rnams byas te/ de nas rang gi mdun du rang la gces shing 'phang pa'i dngos po thams cad phung po chen por spungs te yod par bsam/ rang gi g.yas su pha ma sogs gnyen 'brel/ g.yon du dgra dang 'dre/ rgyab dang mtha' skor du 'khor g.yog dang rig drug gi sems can thams cad nag thibs se yod par bsams la de thams cad rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la rim bzhin du phul bas mnyes bzhin pas bdag gir mdzad/ rang nyid phyin chad 'dzin chags sdang zhen rmongs pa'i las ngan thams cad dang bral bar bsam/ yang rang gi snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas du ma thogs pa nam mkha' gang bar spros te/ de yang bdag gzhan thams cad kyi lus longs spyod thams cad mchod pa'i rgyur byas pa'i mchod pa phul bas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyis bdag gir mdzad de mnyes song snyam pa byas nas phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ sogs nyer spyod kyis mchod/ gzhan yang 'dod yon lnga/ rin chen bdun/ bkra shis rdzas rtags lha rdzas na bza' sogs mchod rdzas du ma thogs pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa rang gi snying ga nas spros/ de rnams kyis rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la mchod/ lha mo rnams rang la tshur thim par bsam pa phyi'i mchod pa'o// yang rang gi snying ga nas lha mo thod pa thogs pa spros/ de rnams kyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dag pa ye shes lnga'i bdud rtsi nas thod pas bcus rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma re re nas phul bas ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gsol/ zag med kyi bde bas thugs mnyes par bsam zhing oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod nas lha mo rnams rang la thim par bsam pa ni nang gi mchod pa'o// yang rang gi snying ga nas lha mo pad can sogs dpag med spros/

de dag gis snyan pa'i glu len bde ba'i gar bsgyur zhing gcig la gcig thim pa'i tshul gyis mthar rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur pa bla ma de dag gi sku la 'khril bas snyoms 'jug gi bde bas mnyes par bsam pa gsang ba'i mchod pa'o// de nas mchod yul mchod mkhan mchod pa'i tshul thams cad gang du'ang ma grub pa'i 'dzin med la blo bzhag pa ni de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'o// de nas ku sā la'i tshogs bsags ni/ rang gi snying ga nas rang sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa gcig lus kyi dbus drang po nas rtsa dbu ma'i lam brgyud spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas rgyang ste thon/ des thur du gzigs pas rang gi lus tsho zhing bsnum pa che zhing brjid pa khrang nger yod pa de'i smin mtshams la phyag g.yas pa'i gri gug gis reg pa tsam gyis thod pa ling gis bkog mdun du thod pa'i sgyed pu ri tsam gsum grub pa'i steng du bkal ba de nyid je cher song ste mthar stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam par gyur/ yang gri gug gis lus kyi rkang pa g.yon g.yas dum bu gsum du bcad nas thod pa'i nang du bskyur/ de bzhin du lus thams cad gcod nas bskyur bas sha'i phung po rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rus pa'i gram khrod chen por gyur par bsam la de la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes lan gsum brjod cing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i rkyen gyis de nyid zhu zhing khol bas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho kha dog dkar ba/ ro mngar ba reg bya bsil ba nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ dran pa tsam gyis bde chen gyi ye shes skye nus pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bsams la byin gyis rlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas lha mo thod pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ de rnams kyis thod pas bdud rtsi nas bcus te rtsa ba'i bla ma la phul bas ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gsol bas mnyes par bsams la/

drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes mchod nas lha mo de rang la thim/ yang spro ba sogs gong bzhin rtsa ba'i bla ma la lan bdun 'bul/ de bzhin du brgyud pa'i bla ma re re'i mtshan la 'bru gsum sbyar ba'am/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod/ gzhan yang bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma gnod sbyin nor lha dam can gter bdag rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes skyabs gnas thams cad la phul bas mnyes par bsam/ yang lha mo rnams spros te/ rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad dang*/ rang la gnod cing lan chags pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad la bdud rtsi sbyin te oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes byin pas bdud rtsi de mthong ba thos pa reg pa myangs pa tsam gyis de dag thams cad tshims shing sgrib gnyis byang*/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sems rtog med chos kyi sku dang lus zag med rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur par bsam la mchod pa'i lha mo rnams tshur bsdu/ thod pa dang sgyed pu mi dmigs par bsam/ khrid dang bsnyen pa'i dus skabs 'dir maṇ+ḍal gang mang 'bul/ de nas rtsa ba'i bla ma la dmigs nas dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs kyis gsol ba rtse gcig tu snying gi khong nas lan gsum gyi bar du btab pas rtsa ba'i bla mas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la spyan kho ro ro gzigs te dbang bzhi bskur mi bskur gyi gnang ba zhus pas/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis rtsa ba'i bla ma la spyan cher gzigs nas de bzhin du gyis/ zhes gnang ba sbyin pa'i tshul gyis bla ma brgyud pa rnams g.yas skor gyis mas nas yar rim bzhin thim/ mthar rdo rje 'chang yang rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim par bsam/ de nas dbang bzhi blang ba ni/ bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las sogs tshig don dran par byed cing dbang bzhi'i dmigs pa'i mthar 'dzin med la ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag

slar yang dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sogs kyis gsol ba phur tshugs su btab pas bla ma de nyid dbu'i gtsug tor nas mar 'od du zhu/ gdan seng khri nas yar 'od du zhu ba thugs ka'i thad du 'od dmar ser li khri'i mdog can snum la 'dril ba bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur pa de nyid bde hril gyis byung nas rang gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs snying ga'i bam̐ yig dmar po de nyid la sibs te thim pas/ bam̐ yig de nyid je cher song nas 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur par bsams la bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med du bsres pa gshis skye med stong gsal du rjen ne/ gdangs 'gags med mos gus su lam me ba'i ngang du sems ji tsam gnas kyi bar du mnyam par bzhag de nas drug pa bdag lhar bskyed pa ni/ rang gi snying gar e byi ru'i mdog can nyis brtsegs/ de 'od du zhu ba las chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi 'og ma dmar gtor gru gsum mgo mjug ldog pa lta bu'i zur gcig mdun dang zur gnyis rgyab phyogs su bstan pa/ steng ma gdan thabs kyi rnam pa can zur gcig rgyab dang zur gnyis mdun phyogs su bstan pa/ de nyid kyi dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po gyen lang*/ de'i mdun nas brtsams te oṃ gsum ma g.yon skor bya tshul sin+dhu ra'i maṇ+ḍal dang mthun pa/ yig 'bru gyen lang 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba/ bam̐ yig sngags dang bcas pa'i 'od zer gyis lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ lus 'od dmar po'i phung po gcig tu gyur/ de skad cig de nyid la rje btsun ma'i sku mngon rtogs nang ltar tshig rjes sems kyis 'brang bar gsal btab/ de yang rnal 'byor pa 'khor bar gnas kyang 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pa'i brdar pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ bde chen ye shes gong 'phel gyi brdar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/

'dod chags kyi rnam rtog 'joms pa'i brdar dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i chags pa'i gnas nu ma gnyis kyi bar du zhabs g.yas dang*/ zhe sdang gi rnam rtog 'joms pa'i brdar 'jigs byed nag po'i zhe sdang gi gnas snying ga'i thad du/ gti mug gi rnam rtog 'joms pa'i brdar gti mug gi gnas mgo bo rgyab tu bltab ste/ phrag dog gi gnas dpral ba nas zhabs g.yon gyis mnan pa/ de lta bu'i gdan gyi steng du rang nyid ma dag pa'i phung khams skye mched thams cad sbyangs/ dag pa rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma stong gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can/ sems can gyi don la rjes su chags pas sku mdog dmar po bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ chos thams cad de bzhin nyid du ro gcig pas zhal gcig pa/ bden pa gnyis thugs su chud pas phyag gnyis pa/ dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs pas spyan gsum pa/ mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub brnyes pa'i brdar dag pa mkha' spyod du hrig ger gzigs pa/ 'khor 'das kyi mtha' gnyis spang bas zhabs gnyis/ phyag g.yas rdo rje phyed pas yu ba byas pa'i gri gug 'og 'khor ba'i phyogs su brkyang nas 'jol thabs su 'dzin pas 'khor ba'i rnam rtog gcod par mtshon pa/ phyag g.yon zla ba ltar dkar ba'i thod pa bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba steng phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol bas bde chen gyi ye shes rgyud la skyes par mtshon pa/ phrag pa g.yon par thabs bde ba chen po dang mi 'bral bar mtshon pa'i brdar kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po yu ba brgyad bzhogs lus tshad dang mnyam pa'i mas sner rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa/ steng du phrin las rnam pa bzhis sems can gyi don mdzad pa mtshon pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje phyogs mdog de'i steng du dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun mi nub pa mtshon byed bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ de'i steng du sku gsum rang chas su mtshon pa'i thod skam dkar dmar sngo gsum brtsegs pa/

de'i steng du zung 'jug bde ba chen po mtshon pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa gang pos brgyan pa/ bde stong gi sgra rgyun mi chad par sgrogs pa'i ḍā ma ru dang dril bu dang*/ 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin pa phrag pa g.yon du bkal thabs su bsnams pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga mtshon pa'i thod pa skam po lnga gser gyi rtse phran dang bcas pa'i dbu rgyan dang*/ nang gi ā li kā li lnga bcu dag pa'i thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga zhes pa spyi bor rus pa'i 'khor lo/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ gdu bu/ ske rag dang bcas pa/ gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog las grol ba mtshon byed dbu skra gnag snum mi 'dzings shing*/ ma bcings pas sku smad yan chad si ler khyab pa/ sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de yang thang sku lta bu'i car mo ma yin pa/ ldem sku lta bu'i 'bur mo ma yin pa/ phyi ltas nang gsal nang ltas phyi gsal stong gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can du bsgom/ bdun pa 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang de ltar rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i snying gar gong bzhin chos 'byung nyis brtsegs zla ba bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa gsal btab la/ de dag las 'od zer dmar po nyi ma shar ba ltar 'phros/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas phar song brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad la phog pas snod thams cad gzhal yas khang bcud rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa'i sdug bsngal rgyur bcas sbyangs nas thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur par bsam/ 'o na 'gro ba gzhan la de ltar nus sam zhe na shin tu nus te snang ba thams cad sems kyi rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir ro// brgyad pa dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis rlobs pa ni/ mdzub mo gnyis mdud byas mthe bong gnyis lto sbyar/ sor mo lhag ma 'bar ba ltar byas pa ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i phyag rgya dang bcas te phaiṃ zhes sogs brjod la/

sems kyi dmigs pa ni/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros 'og min na bzhugs pa'i lhan skyes longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ yul so bdun gnas nyer bzhi sogs na bzhugs pa'i zhing skyes sprul pa'i sku/ ma mkha' 'gro ma yin pa'i bu mor skyes pa ni rigs las skyes pa/ rang nyid kyis sngar sbyangs pa'i 'gro ba rnal 'byor mar gyur pa rnams ni sngags las skyes pa/ de lta bu'i pho nya rnams la phog pas thugs brgyud bskul nas/ steng nas byon pa rnams kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa lta bur thib thib/ 'og nas byon pa rnams dbyar gyi sa rlangs brdol ba ltar bun long long*/ bar nas byon pa rnams dge 'dun mang po chos 'khor la 'du ba ltar 'ur di ri ri byon/ rang rje btsun mar gsal ba la bye ma la chu sim pa ltar gnyis su med par thim par bsams la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod la phyag rgya kyai rdor nas 'byung ba ltar byed cing bstim/ de ltar ye shes pa gzhug pa'i bde ba chen po'i rkyen gyis rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig 'od du zhu ba las dbus su srog gi ngo bo bam̐ dang*/ phyogs bzhir g.yon skor du 'byung bzhi'i ngo bo ya ra la wa'i yi ger gyur pa'i mtha' skor gyi sngags phreng yig 'bru sum cu rtsa gnyis dang bcas pa de rnams lhar gsal ba ni/ dbus su rnal 'byor ma dmar mo/ mdun du dkar mo/ g.yon du ljang gu/ rgyab tu dmar mo/ g.yas su ser mo/ mtha' skor gyi rnal 'byor ma

lus dkyil 'di'i gtso mo ni rdo rje phag mo dang*/ phyogs bzhi'i 'khor snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi/ mtha' skor so gnyis/ yul nyer bzhi'i dpa' mo dang*/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi ngo bor yin pas/ phag mo so bdun ma'i dkyil 'khor dngos su tshang zhing*/ yum gyi gnas su yab gnyis su med pas 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyang shugs la tshang bas/ lū dril nag gsum gyi dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i lha sngags thams cad tshang zhing bsgrub bde bas khyad par du 'phags tshul shes dgos/ mchan/ rnams dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod du gzigs pa sogs nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar brjod cing gsal 'debs pa'am/ bsam pas kyang rung ste lus dkyil gsal gdab/ de yang 'di rnams la 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi zhabs gnon las pad nyi'i gdan med/ lus dkyil kyi gtso mo mtheb sor tsam dang*/ 'khor rnams de'i phyed tsam du gsal gdab gsungs/ pad skor gyi mthar 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i bde chen gyi ye shes su bdag nyid rnam par dag la/ de bzhin du chos thams cad kyang dag go snyam pa'i nga rgyal bzung zhing rig pa 'dzin med du bzhag de nas go cha bcing ba ni/ phyi nang gi lha thams cad kyi lte ba/ snying ga lce'i dkyil/ smin mtshams nas sor gnyis tsam gyi gong gi thad de dpral ba/ skra mtshams nas sor bzhi yar gzhal ba'i sa spyi gtsug dpung pa'i tshigs gnyis/ 'khrig ma'i tshigs gnyis/ dpyi mig gnyis dang bol tshigs gnyis te tshigs chen brgyad bcas de rnams su chu nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin zla dkyil chung ngu re re'i steng du ngo bo lha la rnam pa yig 'bru'i gzugs can zla ba rgyab yol gyi tshul byas pa rnams tshig dang dmigs pa sbrags te gsal btab/ skabs 'dir sems 'dzin nga rgyal rnam pa spyi bye brag rgyan med rgyan can rnams la sems 'dzin bya/

dgu pa bzlas pa la ngag bzlas yid bzlas gnyis kyi dang po ngag bzlas ni/ lus dkyil gyi gtso mo'i thugs kar chos 'byung nyis brtsegs/ de'i steng du zla ba sngags phreng bam̐ yig dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa'i sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad sbyangs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ pho nya gsum gyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu/ mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par tshur 'dus snying ga'i sngags phreng la thim par bsam nas lag pa g.yon pas rab thod phreng brgya rtsa brgyad dam/ yang na bho dhi tsi brgya rtsa brgyad bzung nas dal brel ran par oṃ gsum ma brgya stong la sogs pa nas dam bca' la nyung mtha' byas pa bzlas/ 'di ni gtso bo bzlas bsgom la brten nas mkha' spyod bsgrub pa yin pas nges par bzlas brjod la brtson par bya'o// gnyis pa yid bzlas ni/ thog mar rlung ro sna bug g.yon nas bus/ de nas g.yas/ de nas gnyis ka nas bus la dbugs ngal gso/ de nas thog mar 'og rlung sor bzhi tsam 'then/ de nas steng rlung chil gyis mnan pa dang dus mnyam du mchil ma zhig mid pas snying kha'i chos 'byung zla ba lus dkyil dang bcas pa lte ba'i thad du ldigs kyis skyur 'og rlung dang steng rlung gnyis ka rdzogs par mnan la rlung bum pa can 'dzin/ yid kyis lus dkyil gyi lha rnams yig 'bru'i gzugs su bsgyur ya ra la wa bzhi bam̐ yig la thim par bsams la/ de nas sngags phreng klog pa'i tshul du oṃ gsum ma ci thub 'dren/ mi thub na rlung sna bug nas lhag ma ma lus par sir gyis gtang*/ 'di ni spros bcas kyi rdzogs rim du yang 'gyur bar gsungs pas spro zhing long yod na 'ga' zhig bskyar/ slar yang zhar byung gi rdzogs rim bde stong sgrub pa'i dmigs pa ni/

rang rje btsun mar gsal ba'i lte bar chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs mdun rgyab spang pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon skor du dmar khyi ri ri 'khor ba dang*/ gsang gnas su dga' 'khyil dmar po g.yon skor du 'khor ba/ smin mtshams su dga' 'khyil dkar po g.yon skor du 'khor bar dmigs nas rlung bum pa can bzung zhing bde ba'i ye shes skye bar 'dod na gsang gnas kyi dga' 'khyil la dmigs pa drag tu gtad/ bde ba ches nas mi bzod pa lta bu byung na stong pa'i ye shes skye ba'i phyir smin mtshams kyi dga' ba 'khyil pa la dmigs pa drag tu gtad/ 'di yun ring du bsgom na du ba la sogs pa rtags rnams rim par 'byung bar 'gyur ro// yang rdzogs rim gnyis pa bsgom par 'dod pas/ rang rje btsun mar gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma chos bzhi ldan sba lcag 'bring po tsam drang du thal ler yod pa/ mas sner gsang gnas dang yas sne spyi gtsug nas sba gug ltar gug ste smin mtshams su zug pa'i mas sner dga' ba 'khyil pa mtshal lcog las bris pa lta bu rtsa dbu ma la reg la ma 'byar ba g.yon skor du dmar khyi ri ri 'khor ba/ yas sner dga' 'khyil shel dkar gyis bris pa lta bu g.yon skor du dkar khyi ri ri 'khor ba la dmigs nas/ thog mar mas sna rlung 'then pas mas kyi dga' 'khyil rgya mthongs nas bya 'phur ba ltar rtsa dbu ma'i nang brgyud/ snying ga'i thad du g.yon skor du shugs drag tu 'khor ba la dmigs pa gtad pas snang ba thams cad bde cham cham gyur snang ba mched pa'i lam sbyangs/ de nas steng rlung chil gyis mnan pas yas sne'i dga' 'khyil thog mar bya nam mkha' la yang 'phur ba ltar smin mtshams nas spyi bo'i bar gyen du song*/ de nas bya thur du 'babs pa ltar snying ga'i dga' 'khyil dmar po'i steng du babs g.yon skor du shugs drag tu 'khor ba la dmigs pa gtad pas snang ba thams cad stong cham cham du gyur snang ba thob pa'i lam sbyangs/

de nas rlung bum pa can 'dzin pa'i dus su snying ga'i thad du dga' 'khyil gnyis reg la ma 'byar tsam du drag tu 'khor zhing mthar dga' 'khyil gnyis khrug chil gyis 'dres pas dga' 'khyil dmar skya g.yon skor du drag tu 'khor ba la dmigs pa gtad mthar dga' 'khyil dbu ma la thim/ dbu ma yang 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur par bsam nas rlung sna bug nas dal bus btang*/ 'di bsgoms pas bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rgyud la skye zhing snang ba nyer thob sbyong bar byed pas da lta nas 'bad pas bsgom par bya'o// bcu pa bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor la thun mong ba mngon rtogs kyi dkyus ltar dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa gser chos chig brgyud gnyis las 'dir phyi ma nyams su len par byed pa la thun bsdu ba'i tshe/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar srab pa/ chu shing gi sdong po ltar drang pa/ rgya skyegs kyi me tog ltar dmar ba/ til mar gyi sgron me ltar gsal ba ste chos bzhi ldan/ yar sna spyi gtsug tu zug pa cig bsam/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar mo/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar mo/ de gnyis ka'ang sbom phra go sog 'bring po tsam yar sne spyi gtsug nas sba gug ltar mdun phyogs su 'khyog pa sna bug g.yas g.yon du zug pa/ rtsa gsum ka'ang mar sna lte bar sleb pa/ lte ba'i rtsa gsum 'dzom par bam̐ yig dang rang sems dbyer med pa'i ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam/ sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa gcig bsam/ de la sems zhugs pa bzhin gtad pas/ de las chu las chu bur rdol ba bzhin rdo rje rnal 'byor ma chung ngu zhig nar gyis chad rlung phyir rgyu ba dang mnyam du/ me stag yar ba ltar rtsa g.yas ro ma'i nang nas yar dmar khyug gis byon/ sna bug gi sgor slebs pa dang*/ de las de 'dra ba grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyi zer gyi rdul ltar 'phros snod bcud thams cad khyab/

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul zhing thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ de thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur nas skad cig nyid la tshur byon/ sna g.yon pa'i bu gar sleb pa dang sngar spros pa'i rnal 'byor ma chung ngu me stag tsam de la thams cad thim/ de nyid rlung nang du 'jug pa dang lhan cig tu sna bug g.yon pa nas/ rtsa g.yon rkyang ma'i nang nas mar dmar khyug gis byon/ rlung nang du gnas pa dang*/ lte ba'i rnal 'byor ma la thim par bsam zhing rlung ci thub 'dzin/ de lta bu spro bsdu lan bdun nam gsum la sogs pa ci rigs pas lam sbyangs pa'i mthar/ lte ba'i rnal 'byor ma las 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad khyab/ yan lag rnams 'od du zhu nas lus kyi rdza ma la thim/ de nyid kyang 'od zer dmar por gyur/ de tsam na lte ba'i rang sems rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod du 'byon par chas nas steng phyogs su nar tsam byon dbu ma'ang dbu gtsug tu thim pas a je thung du gyur/ g.yas g.yon gyi rtsa gnyis kyi mar sna'ang gyen du gug nas rnal 'byor ma'i zhabs mthil gnyis la 'byar ba gyen du 'then pas je thung du gyur/ de nas rim bzhin snying ga dang mgrin pa'i thad sogs su rnal 'byor ma rim gyis yar byon pas rtsa gsum kyang de tsam du 'dus/ lus kyi ngo bo 'od kyi gong bu'ang smad nas rim bzhin yal nas der thim/ rang sems kyi ngo bo rnal 'byor ma spyi gtsug tu byon pa dang mnyam du rtsa gsum lus 'od phung dang bcas pa thams cad rnal 'byor ma la sib kyis thim/ de'i rkyen gyis rnal 'byor ma de nyid kyang nam mkha' la me stag yar ba'am/ rtsal po ches mda' nam mkhar 'phangs pa ltar nam mkha'i dbyings blos mi 'khyud pa tsam na yar ye re re byon/ nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba'am du ba yal ba ltar chos sku stong nyid kyi ngang du thim par bsams la/ gsal stong zung 'jug gi ngang du ji tsam gnas kyi bar du lus sems lhod kyis glod la mnyam par 'jog

yang mkha' dbyings su rang sems rnal 'byor ma mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa de nyid thol gyis byung*/ bya thur du 'babs pa ltar mar byon nas rang gnas su byon/ phyi'i lus kyang sngar ltar grub par bsams la sngar gyi dmigs pa de nyid tshar nyer gcig gam/ bdun nam/ gsum la sogs pa stabs dang bstun par bya'o// de'i ngang las rang nyid thun mtshams kyi rje btsun ma rgyan dang phyag mtshan med pa'i skur ldang zhing go cha bgo ba ni/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ zhes pa nas/ phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bos mtshan par gyur/ zhes brjod la go cha'i lha tshogs rnams gong bzhin gsal gdab/ bsrung ba ni lag pa g.yon pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis se gol phyogs g.yon skor dang mtshams g.yas skor du gdab cing sngags brjod pa ni/ shar dang steng du khwa gdong ma sngon mo re grub par bsams la/ oṃ sum+bha ni sogs dang*/ byang du 'ug gdong ma ljang gu grub par bsams la oṃ gṛh+ṇa sogs dang*/ nub dang 'og tu khyi gdong ma dmar mo bsams la/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya sogs dang*/ lhor phag gdong ma ser po bsams la oṃ ā na ya sogs brjod/ de bzhin du mtshams rnams g.yas skor gyis sum+bha sogs brjod pas/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo ser dmar/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba mo dmar ljang*/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma ljang sngon rnams grub par bsams la oṃ sum+bha sogs brjod/ de lta bu'i sgo mtshams ma brgyad po thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang pos ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ/ 'og gnyis gri thod thogs pa grangs med spros te srung ba'i gur du bzhugs par bsam/ slar yang oṃ sum+bha sogs tshar gcig brjod la thams cad brtan zhing nus ldan du bsam mo// de nas dge ba bsngo ba dang mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam sogs bya/

bcu gcig pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la dngos dang 'phros don gnyis las/ dang po ni rang dang snang ba thams cad rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur bsgom pa ni sku'i dga' ba/ sgrar ci grag pa thams cad oṃ gsum ma'i sgrar bsgom pa gsung gi dga' ba/ sems kyi yul du bzang ngan gyi rtog pa gang shar yang gsal stong 'dzin med spros bral gyi ngang du 'jog pa ni thugs kyi dga' ba ste/ gzhung gzhan nas khyer so gsum gsung ba dang yang gnad gcig go /kha zas bza' btung gang byed kyang oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas bdud rtsir byin gyis rlabs nas snying ga'i bam̐ yig sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo de mchod par bsam pas longs spyod/ de bzhin du gos gyon pa'i tshe yang 'bru gsum brjod pas lha rdzas kyi gos pañca li kar mos pas longs spyod na bu lon du mi 'gyur zhing tshogs rdzogs par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa 'phros don la thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul ba'i tshul ni/ dku bag dang 'brel ba'i gtor ma dkar po zlum po pad 'dab bzhis bskor ba rgyan ldan zhig bshams/ bsam mi khyab grub rjes rang thun mtshams kyi lhar gsal ba'i ngang*/ nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs la/ byin gyis rlabs pa dang 'bul tshul sogs mngon rtogs nas byung ba bzhin bya'o// de nas bsnyen pa/ sbyin sreg mar me'i sbyin sreg bya tshul rnams gong ma'i yi ge ltar shes par bya'o// de lta bu'i nyams len la chig dril du brtson par byas na dbang po rab skal ldan rnams tshe 'di nyid la lus ma spang bar mkha' spyod du 'khrid par byed/ 'bring gis 'chi kha/ tha mas bar do/ yang tha skye ba bdun nam bcu drug tshun chad du nges par mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su bgrod pa ni nges par yang dag pa'o// gal te nyams len gyi 'bras bu ji lta ba bzhin ma 'grub na laṅka li ya'i shing la brten nas mkha' spyod bsgrub par bya dgos pas/

de'i tshul ni khrid yig chen mo las 'byung ba ltar bya'o// gzhan yang 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud las/ tshes bcu la ni de rab mchod// zhes gsungs pa ltar tshogs gsog par 'dod na yar ngo dang*/ sgrib pa sbyong bar 'dod na mar ngo'i tshes bcu gang rung la/ rab tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad pa'i mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i nye lam la ji ltar 'byung ba ltar tshes bcu'i mchod pa rgyas par bya ba'am de tsam ma 'grub na oṃ gsum ma dam bca'i grangs nyis 'gyur bya ba dang*/ bu mo gzhon nu ma grong pa'i chos kyi ma gos pa lnga'am drug sogs bza' btung gis tshim par bya ba sogs de dag rnams nyams su blang bar bya'o// gtan bde'i rgyal rnga khams gsum las 'das pa// rang min brdung la dwangs pa'i 'dod pa can// gang dag su yod rgyal thabs chen po'i sgo// 'dir bzhugs rim gnyis stegs la rtag 'dzeg mdzod// dbang po rab 'bring lus 'dis mkha' la spyod// tha mas 'chi dang bar do'i skabs su 'pho// yang tha skye ba brgyud nas rig 'dzin grong*// nyul ba'i thabs tshul 'di ko bla na med// yang zab gdams pa'i nor bu 'di dag gis// sngon chad bslus pa su yang ma mchis mod// rang gis rang bslus bdag 'dra'i rigs can la// gdams pas sa steng khyab kyang stong par zad// 'khor bar sngon chad 'khyams pa des chog mod// da ni thar pa'i thabs la 'bad par rigs// gzhan du gshin rje a wa glang mgo khong*// rngams brjid che la rwa tso rno bar gda'// 'di bris dge ba ci mchis mkha' mnyam 'gror// bsngo'o rmongs pa'i skyon gyis nyes pa'i cha// gang yod bla ma mkha' 'gros bzod mdzod la// bkra shis snang bas khyab pa'i dge legs stsol// ces 'jam mgon sa skya pa'i zab chos rje btsun mkha' spyod rdo rje btsun mo'i bskyed rdzogs kyi dmigs rim 'khrug sdebs med pa'i 'khyer bde kun tshang zhig sgrigs dgos tshul a mdo dge slong byams pa phrin las yon tan nas lha rdzas rin gnyis kyi rten bcas nan du smras par brten rmor chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i gser gyi yang zhun dang*/

gnas gsar rjes mdzad pa'i rgyun 'khyer rgyas pa gnyis gung sgrigs/ dmigs pa'i cha 'ga' zhig cung kha gsal bar byas te/ gzims 'og sprul ming 'dzin pa byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phrin las kyis bkod pa yin cing*/ lar na dam pa gong ma'i gsung rab khyad par can yod bzhin du 'di 'dra bris pa la dgos tshogs ma mthong na'ang*/ gdul bya'i khams dang bsam pa dang dbang po dang bag la nyal sogs dang mthun pa'ang re gnyis 'byung srid phyir 'di nyid bris pa la shes ldan rnam mi khrel ba mkhyen mkhyen/ yi ge pa ni bskul pa po nyid do// dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
